newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Africwest plans ASX listing on July 3.
newsitem.headline: Africwest plans ASX listing on July 3.

text.p: West African-focused gold exploration company Africwest Gold NL said on Thursday it expects to list on the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) on July 3 after raising A$8.75 million in an oversubscribed public float.
Perth-based Africwest said it plans to target gold deposits of more than one million ounces in Ghana, Guinea and the Ivory Coast unexplored by western standards.
About A$2.8 million is budgeted for exploration during its first 12 months as a listed company, rising to A$3.6 million in the second year, it said.
Africwest closed off its public share offer of 40 million shares issued at 20 Australian cents each and one free option attaching to every three shares a week ago.
Africwest holds tenements covering some 2,000 square kilometres in West Africa, it said.
